description: Traffic Counting Data Processing System of North Macedonia provides a national traffic-count processing service using fixed road counters, API access and Excel reports. The provider is Public Enterprise for State Roads, North Macedonia. Geographical and temporal coverage: The provider states 71 counters on North Macedonia's state roads, submitting data every 24 hours. The linked provider page supplies the access route and documentation; the resource payload was not retrieved. The licence is not stated in inspected metadata. A price for reuse is not established; consult the provider. Caveats: The page requests contact for report access. Neither protected API data nor counter completeness was checked. For simulation, the documented contents can support transport network modelling and capacity planning. This use is an interpretation of the metadata, not a tested integration. No directly related existing catalogue record was established.
